profile.headline: Hardware/Software Engineer at Nuventex LED Solutions
profile.summary:
Electrical Engineer with a proven background in multiple hardware and software applications.  Comprehensive experience in each aspect of the application lifecycle - development, testing, manufacturing, sustaining.  

Expertise includes
•	LED Applications	•	Manufacturing - Onshore and Offshore
•	Hardware Design 	•	Tool Development
•	Software Development, Testing & Sustaining	•	Patents and Publications
•	Customer Interface	•	Compliancy and Certifications


TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: 	Visual C++, MFC, C, VBA, ActiveX, ATL, STL, Java, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, DevStudio, Access, SQL, dBase, i960 and X86 assembly, Windows API, Windows Sockets, Qt, APL, PL1, PLS, Fortran, X86 Assembly, i960 C/assembly, proprietary IBM, Silicon Labs, TI microprocessors,VHDL

Hardware: 	Microprocessor controlled LED driver boards, Video conferencing boards, Optical disk drive controller, and Automated test systems

Testing:	BIOS and application software testing of Xplore tablets. Developed GPIB based automated test systems for testing high-end tape drives and optical disk drives

positions.title: Hardware/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed several LED products (from high bright outdoor lighting applications to wearable art)
o	Design and layout of LED driver boards 
o	Developed software for the C8051F920 MCU to control the LED driver board.
•	Manufacturing Support of Lighting Manufacture (LED Replacement for Fluorescent light bulbs).
•	Wrote various software applications 
o	Web Page 
o	Accounting application using Visual Basic

positions.title: Senior Hardware/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed LED high bright displays for Xplore’s new line of tablet PC’s. 
•	Developed PXE disk imaging system to speed up manufacturing throughput.
•	Tested BIOS and ODM application software. 
•	Worked with ODM to resolve software issues and fix problems. 
•	Developed hardware and software tools to aid in tablet testing.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
•	Developed Statistical Analysis package for Semiconductor Industry. Written using C++ and STL. The GUI was written with Qt toolkit. 
•	Extensive use of object oriented techniques to expedite development and maintenance
•	Developed Access Application to provide business statistics, automate invoicing and purchase orders.
•	Networked computers, performed general PC debug,  and software installation and setup

positions.title: Senior Hardware/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote Visual C++ and RISC firmware applications
o	Developed a WDM virtual device driver to support the newest version of NetMeeting
o	Developed a Remote Control Pad to control the videoconference over a wired/wireless LAN (Windows platform or Windows CE device. The server and client applications used ATL ActiveX controls and the MFC CAsync Socket class)
o	Added ATM communications support
•	Sustained application software, RISC firmware, and Hardware sustaining of video conferencing platform hardware
